robots_note: No robots.txt (404). No auth for public catalogue reads in principle, but the API returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to this environment on 2026-06-02 (both the research and a browser User-Agent), i.e. an IP-level block of datacentre traffic, not a UA issue. The harvester surfaces this as a partial/empty snapshot and the swarm falls back. Retry from a residential/EU IP. limit hard-capped at 75.
notes: avaandmed.eesti.ee 301-redirects to andmed.eesti.ee (Teabevarav). NOT CKAN: custom NestJS API. NO national DCAT-AP RDF feed (all /catalog.* return the Angular SPA HTML shell). List at /api/datasets?page&limit=75 (metadata.total=5708; the v2/v3 search endpoints report 8168 because they also count data services/series, use the dataset-level 5708). Detail at /api/datasets/{id} carries distributions[] with license (code e.g. CC_BY_4.0, CC_BY_SA_4.0), format, accessUrls. Empty-string license counts as unlicensed. Conformance metrics require synthesising DCAT-AP RDF from this JSON. data.europa.eu not used.
